quote_revision.description: Opaque revision of the displayed quote; echo it when confirming.

buyer_fingerprint.description: Opaque revision of buyer details and email policy; never full VIES evidence.

operation_key.description: Client-generated UUID persisted before the start request. Unique per org and reused only for identical input.

invoice_id.description: The due charge or issued invoice, for invoice-paying operations.

original_amount.description: Recorded balance of a held invoice; not a new quote or authorization.

operation_key.description: Client-generated UUID persisted before the start request. Unique per org and reused only for identical input.

invoice_id.description: The due charge or issued invoice, for invoice-paying operations.

operation_key.description: Client-generated UUID persisted before the start request. Unique per org and reused only for identical input.

invoice_id.description: The due charge or issued invoice, for invoice-paying operations.

available.description: Whether this cloud takes payments at all — `false` when no Mollie key is configured.

company_name.description: The company's legal name, printed on the invoice.

vat_id.description: The company's VAT ID, or `null` for none. Required for a new purchase in another EU country; direct VIES must confirm it with an identifier.

tax_id.description: Free-text Tax ID. Required for a new non-EU purchase; historical records may omit it.

line1.description: Street and number, or the first address line.

line2.description: A second address line, or `null` when there is none.

country.description: The billing country, used for purchase eligibility and VAT.

state.description: State or region. A new US purchase requires a two-letter state code; historical addresses may omit it.

invoice_email.description: Where invoices and billing mail are sent.

oneOf.description: A company: name and an optional VAT ID, never 'full name'.

full_name.description: The person's full name, printed on the invoice.

line1.description: Street and number, or the first address line.

line2.description: A second address line, or `null` when there is none.

country.description: The billing country, used for purchase eligibility and VAT.

state.description: State or region. A new US purchase requires a two-letter state code; historical addresses may omit it.

invoice_email.description: Where invoices and billing mail are sent.

oneOf.description: A person: a full name, never a VAT ID — only a company can be VAT-registered.

payer.description: Who is paying, and the invoice address and email.

vat_id_status.description: The payer's VAT ID check, or `null` when no VAT ID was given.

rate_percent.description: The VAT rate, in whole percent.

vat.description: Recorded VAT treatment; null while the current buyer has no eligible decision. Never infer zero rating from a pending account.

currency.description: The org's billing currency, fixed at the first payment.

period_starts_at.description: The current period's start. `null` before the first payment.

period_ends_at.description: The current period's end. `null` before the first payment.

at.description: When the next charge is due.

net_cents.description: The next charge, excluding VAT, in integer cents.

vat_cents.description: VAT on the next charge, in integer cents.

gross_cents.description: The next charge including VAT, in integer cents.

next_charge.description: `null` while a cancel is pending or nothing else renews.

cycle.description: A cycle change queued for the period's end, or `null`.

app_user_packs.description: Packs of five extra app users.

live_video_packs.description: Packs of 250 extra hours of app-user live video per month.

addons.description: Add-on counts queued for the period's end, or `null`.

scheduled.description: What takes effect at the period's end.

invoice_id.description: What dunning is chasing: a historical open `FL-…` invoice, or a due charge. Before the issuer cutover a due charge appears here only while the payer's VAT ID is unsettled; it has no number yet, is not in `invoices`, and `POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay` takes either. After the cutover this is always a due charge (in `charges`): pay it with `POST /api/billing/charges/:id/pay`.

gross_cents.description: The amount owed, in integer cents — after a partial chargeback only the charged-back part.

due_at.description: The charge's due date; retries and the lock count from here.

next_retry_at.description: The next automatic retry, or `null` once retries are exhausted. Always `null` after a chargeback: a charged-back payment is never charged again automatically.

lock_at.description: When the org is locked if still unpaid (`BILLING_LOCK_DAY`).

failure.description: Mollie's own reason, e.g. 'card_expired'; 'vat_id_invalid' while a renewal is held because VIES does not confirm the VAT ID; 'charged_back' after a chargeback or a lost PayPal dispute.

dunning.description: `null` while nothing is overdue. During a VAT-ID hold the charge is due but not yet invoiced.

account.description: `null` before the org has ever checked out.

brand.description: The card network, as Mollie's mandate reports it, e.g. 'Visa'.

last4.description: The last four digits of the card.

expires.description: Expiry as Mollie's mandate shows it, 'MM/YY'.

kind.description: A card mandate from an Apple Pay first payment — Mollie stores it as `creditcard`; Fleetless labels it Apple Pay.

brand.description: The card network, as Mollie's mandate reports it, e.g. 'Mastercard'.

last4.description: The last four digits of the card behind Apple Pay.

expires.description: Expiry as Mollie's mandate shows it, 'MM/YY'.

account.description: The PayPal account Mollie's mandate names.

payment_method.description: The payment method on file, or `null`.

pays_invoice.description: Whether changing to it also pays the open invoice — `true` only for `applepay` when a zero-amount Apple Pay payment is not available.

payment_method_options.description: What a payment-method change may offer right now, so a client offers exactly what the cloud accepts. `applepay` is absent when it needs an open invoice and none is open; `[]` when the org has no billing account.

issuer.description: Which system issues this org's charges: `cloud` before the issuer cutover, or `lexware` after it.

number.description: The invoice number: `FL-<year>-<seq>`, `seq` zero-padded to four digits, gapless per calendar year in `Europe/Berlin`.

cancellation_document_url.description: Relative same-origin path `/api/billing/invoices/<id>/pdf?kind=cancellation` for a cancelled historical Cloud invoice with a stored cancellation number and PDF; otherwise `null`. The path uses this invoice's id, not the cancellation number.

net_cents.description: The charge, excluding VAT, in integer cents.

vat_rate_percent.description: The VAT rate applied, in whole percent.

gross_cents.description: Net plus VAT, in integer cents.

invoices.description: Cloud-issued invoices from before the issuer cutover; read-only, never grows after it. Newest first, at most 24.

id.description: The due charge's id — never a Cloud invoice number. Pay it with `POST /api/billing/charges/:id/pay`.

kind.description: What caused the charge: the first charge after checkout, a scheduled renewal, or a mid-period plan change.

status.description: The charge's own status. A charged back or manually refunded charge stays `paid` — refunds and chargebacks are handled in Mollie or Lexware by hand; this status and the invoice it names are unchanged, and the resulting Lexware credit note appears under `GET /api/billing/documents` instead.

currency.description: Every charge billed through Lexware is EUR.

net_cents.description: The charge, excluding VAT, in integer cents.

vat_rate_percent.description: The VAT rate applied, in whole percent.

gross_cents.description: Net plus VAT, in integer cents.

paid_at.description: When this charge was paid, or `null` while unpaid.

state.description: Not collected (due, a failed retry, or uncollectible): no invoice exists.
Collected; the Lexware invoice is not yet confirmed.

document_id.description: The Lexware document's id — read it with `GET /api/billing/documents/:id`.

invoice.description: Whether a Lexware invoice exists for this charge yet, and which document it names once it does.

charges.description: Newest first, at most 24. Lists only due charges with issuer `lexware` — never a pre-cutover charge, a legacy payment (legacy_issued/legacy_held/legacy_person/legacy_usd) or a late USD collection: none of those carry a Lexware intent, and they stay in `invoices` or nowhere. `[]` while `issuer` is `cloud`.
